rules.statement: The cause of action survives to the surviving partner when one of several partners dies, and does not need to be joined with the legal representatives of the deceased partner.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think it is clear from the authorities, both English and Indian, which have been cited to us, that although his interest in partnership property passed to his executor, yet the remedy in respect of that property survived to the surviving partner alone, and that it could be brought in his name alone"
